record.question: Systemic circulation of blood was discovered by:
record.explanation: Answer D: William Harvey. William Harvey described and demonstrated systemic circulation of blood in De Motu Cordis (1628). Reference: https://library.si.edu/digital-library/book/exercitatioanat00harv; https://collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/objects/co67303/harvey-demonstrating-to-king-charles-i-his-theory-of-the-circulation-of-the-blood-print-london-england-1851-print. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
